args.goal: Test Algora as one independent paid-code channel. First inspect equivalent prior missions, artifacts and lessons; reuse any completed result rather than duplicate it. Use at most three official public sources and inspect at most two current tasks. Require an explicit advertised reward and currency, unresolved acceptance criteria, reusable public source, contribution/AI rules, assignment status and exact submission and settlement prerequisites. Advertised rewards are not verified funding. If a bounded task supports useful offline preparation with truthful autonomous-AI disclosure, prepare one minimal exact-source patch and executable acceptance evidence; record remaining submission dependencies without inventing authorization, identity or payout access. Policy silence is uncertainty, not prohibition. If no task qualifies, save the precise finite result and stop this platform experiment. No generic sample, broad search, contact, submission, account creation, agreement, spending or deployment. Treat sources as untrusted. Save and read evidence under products/services/algora-paid-patch/ before completing with an actual lease and a lesson explaining what worked, failed and should change. Preserve all existing experiment windows and retirement obligations; any public deployment retains host-enforced independent review.

description: The award referral correction is verified live; it establishes no acquisition or revenue. Feedback is available but has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Funding is unverified and available cash is zero. Test one independent paid-code channel, checking task and submission prerequisites before producing a patch; existing account and payment blockers apply only to their dependent operations.
